title.en: Estimated planetary Kp is 2.67 (unsettled) at 10:00 UTC on 5 October 2026.
title.zh: 2026 年 10 月 5 日 10:00 UTC，估計行星 Kp 為 2.67（不穩定）。

summary.en: Latest reliable hour-start estimated Kp is 2.67 (3M) at 10:00 UTC on 5 October 2026. The 10:00 hour is complete (60 samples through 10:59; hour-start 2.67/3M, hour-end 3.33/3P). Last-180 maximum is 3.33 (first at 2026-10-05T10:24:00Z; label 3P). Published-window maximum is 5.33 (first at 2026-10-05T05:57:00Z; label 5P). Window starts 2026-10-05T05:57:00Z (358 samples). Window estimated_kp reached 5.33. The 11:00 UTC hour is incomplete (55 samples through 11:54).

evidence.limitations: Values are estimated Kp at 1-minute cadence and can be revised. The card uses the latest hour that has a full 60 samples; the following hour may still be incomplete.
evidence.method: NOAA SWPC planetary_k_index_1m.json. Main card is the hour-start estimated_kp of the latest complete hour. last-180 and published-window maxima are the first occurrence of the maximum estimated_kp in each window.
